sources.entry: AI Rap Video - AI rap video generator: write or draft rap lyrics, pick a photo, original character or duo, and get a short lip-synced rap clip (8-15s); packs from $4.99. #paid

summary.name: AI Rap Video
summary.one_liner: A paid web generator that turns lyrics you write into a short 8, 12, or 15 second lip-synced rap clip of an original character, a photo you have permission to use, or two photos.
use_cases: Make a short rap clip of an original character
Turn a selfie into a lip-synced rap verse
Create a birthday or occasion rap video
Make a two-person rap battle clip with consent
Draft and test a 12 second hook for a longer video
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes lyrics you paste or draft from a topic and renders an 8, 12, or 15 second MP4 of a performer rapping them. Three modes are offered: AI Rapper (an original character described in text, real faces blocked), Selfie (one photo you have permission to use), and Duo (two photos, lip-sync anchored on the first). Standard mode uses Wan 2.2 lip-sync at 480p; Pro uses OmniHuman 1.5 and adds hand and body gestures at 720p. Voices can be male, female, or auto, and the page says voices are not clones. Pricing is by credits, 5 per second for Standard and 10 per second for Pro, with drafting lyrics free and failed renders refunded.
notable: Three modes: AI Rapper for an original character, Selfie for one photo, Duo for two photos
Standard (Wan 2.2 lip-sync) and Pro (OmniHuman 1.5 with gestures) tiers
Free lyrics drafting; failed renders return credits
Does not accept uploaded songs and states it does not clone voices or build the Hotel Lobby booth trend
caveats: Paid: credits from $4.99 (one 12s Standard clip = 60 credits); no free render and no free credits on signup
Clips are limited to 8, 12, or 15 seconds and cannot take an uploaded song
Duo anchors on the first photo and does not cut between two people or run a shared routine
